title: The First Song
caption: THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter I FINALE, Episode 10: The First Song. Do and Re are home; the Keeper journeys a day and a night to find the five that remain. Mi, asleep in the shade (with Do — the first sweetness, a third). Shy Fa, hiding in the golden mist, until the found ones call it home. Sol, blazing on the far hill (with Do — the strongest thread, a fifth). La, singing longing to the night wind. And restless Ti, forever leaning toward Do — one half step from home; that pull is what makes music move. Then, for the first time since the world began, the whole scale is home — and it plays the FIRST SONG. And far away, in the quiet dark... something hears it. End of Chapter I. Chapter II begins soon.  the more you know, the more you observe.  #theobserver #animation #ambient #music #solfege #storytelling
